input.overview: For {duration}, shoppers on io-shop had their account pages fail. IO Payments Ltd, the outside company that handles the shop's payments, began refusing the shop's requests to look up shoppers' saved cards. Each time a lookup was refused, the shopper's account page failed with it. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests were failing. Argus estimates the shop lost {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody was paged, so no on-call responders were called in. Argus did not act on the suspected cause because the failure is in io-pay, a service IO Payments Ltd runs that Argus has no way to reach. Its recommended step is to ask IO Payments Ltd to restore io-pay, and it did not look for a code fix. That step has not been taken.
